description: Analyze a video file. Extracts keyframes and transcripts. RECOMMENDED: First use popcorn_suggest to get optimal settings, or specify videoType and objective to use smart presets.

backend.description: Transcription backend. 'auto' picks the best available. Options: whisper (OpenAI, most compatible), whisper-cpp (fast C++), mlx-whisper (Apple Silicon optimized), faster-whisper (GPU accelerated).

frameMode.description: Override: 'scene' detects visual changes, 'interval' uses fixed timing.

inlineFrames.description: Override: frames to return as base64 in response.

minSceneInterval.description: Override: minimum seconds between scene frames.

model.description: Whisper model: tiny, base, small, medium, large. For whisper-cpp: path to a ggml model file.

objective.description: What you want to accomplish. Options: summary (quick overview), detailed (thorough analysis), find_moment (searching for something specific), transcribe (focus on audio), visual_only (no transcription), quick_scan (fast preview).

videoType.description: Type of video content. This auto-configures optimal settings. Options: screencast (UI recordings, tutorials), presentation (slides, lectures), movie (films, TV), interview (podcasts, talking heads), surveillance (security footage), sports (live action).

name: popcorn_analyze
